name: ClickHELP
postCreateCommand: npm run install:all && (test -f backend/.env || cp backend/.env.example backend/.env) && (test -f frontend/.env || cp frontend/.env.example frontend/.env)

DATABASE_URL.description: Connection string da branch dev no Neon. Sem ela, o backend usa um banco local embutido.

JWT_SECRET.description: Segredo dos tokens de login (mínimo de 32 caracteres).
